# System variables in function and view definitions
# https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/system-variables
#
# BigQuery rejects a temporary function or a view whose definition refers to @@dataset_id, as
# errors/scripts.txt checks. These cases settle what those answers leave open. The scripts that
# need a dataset create unverified_dataset_system_variables, which stays in the project after
# they run.

# Whether the error comes from the definition or only from a call.
SET @@dataset_id = 'before';
CREATE TEMP FUNCTION f() AS (@@dataset_id);
SELECT 1
?>

# The error without an assignment to the variable earlier in the script.
CREATE TEMP FUNCTION f() AS (@@dataset_id);
SELECT f()
?>

# The error for a permanent function, which names it with its dataset.
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS unverified_dataset_system_variables;
SET @@dataset_id = 'unverified_dataset_system_variables';
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION unverified_dataset_system_variables.f() AS (@@dataset_id);
SELECT unverified_dataset_system_variables.f()
?>

# Whether an EXCEPTION clause handles the error, and the message it then sees.
BEGIN
  CREATE TEMP FUNCTION f() AS (@@dataset_id);
EXCEPTION WHEN ERROR THEN
  SELECT @@error.message;
END
?>

# The same for a view that dynamic SQL defines.
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS unverified_dataset_system_variables;
BEGIN
  EXECUTE IMMEDIATE 'CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW unverified_dataset_system_variables.v AS SELECT @@dataset_id AS dataset_id';
EXCEPTION WHEN ERROR THEN
  SELECT @@error.message;
END
?>

# Whether system variables other than the dataset ones are rejected in definitions too.
CREATE TEMP FUNCTION f() AS (@@project_id);
SELECT f() IS NOT NULL
?>
